checkpoint_rule: Fixed final epoch for every arm; selection CE is diagnostic only. No evaluation-based tuning.
cohort: Exact saved row IDs from the preceding feature study. Same 60-day OHLCVA history in every arm; no external financial data and no extra pre-window history.
limitations: Reused historical development dates; one seed and four-epoch continuation, not convergence or prospective validation. Same 60-day context means recursive indicators restart at the window boundary and can differ from a chart with years of warm-up. Archived price/adjustment-factor provenance and unresolved tokenizer pretraining overlap remain. No live checkpoint promotion.
ranking: Median T low; modal path peak date in T+1..T+4, earliest tie; median high on that selected date. Rank sell/buy-1-cost. Evaluate actual high on that frozen date / actual T low-1-cost as an extrema scenario, not executable profit.
feature_note: BOLL(20,2), population standard deviation; MACD(12,26,9), first-close-seeded EMA, histogram DIF-DEA; KDJ(9,3,3), K/D seed 50. Indicators use only each sample's existing 60 historical bars. Missing warm-up and undefined zero-width ratios are masked. Features are invariant to uniform price rescaling. No future features, longer history, threshold trading rules or post-result parameter search.
